prompt: The same courier portal shows a delivery confirmation and an amount marked “charged.” For a company-paid booking, that amount is billed to the company, whereas a personal card receipt shows what the employee actually paid. Asked to substantiate an out-of-pocket expense, the employee should _____.
promptZh: 同一個快遞網站顯示送達確認，以及一個標為「已收費」的金額。公司付款的預約會把該金額記到公司帳上，個人卡的收據才顯示員工自己實際付了多少。若被要求證明個人先墊的款項，員工應_____。

options.text: use the personal card receipt to show payment and the delivery confirmation only if delivery itself needs verification
options.zh: 用個人卡收據證明付款；只有要另證明送達時才使用送達確認
options.whyZh: 個人收據證明實際由員工付款；送達確認的證明對象不同。

options.text: use the portal’s charged amount as proof of personal payment whenever it matches the card receipt
options.zh: 只要網站收費金額與卡費收據相同，就以網站金額證明個人付款
options.whyZh: 相同金額不代表付款人相同，公司付款的帳單也可能同額。

options.text: use the personal card receipt to show the amount, but identify the payer from the name of the recipient on the delivery confirmation
options.zh: 用個人卡收據證明金額，但用送達確認上的收件人姓名辨認付款人
options.whyZh: 用個人卡收據確認金額正確，但收件人不一定是付款人；送達資料不能辨認誰墊款。

options.text: use the company billing entry for the employee’s payment and retain the personal receipt only for delivery
options.zh: 用公司帳項證明員工付款，個人收據只留作送達證明
options.whyZh: 把兩種資料的用途對調了；公司帳項不是個人先墊的依據。

explanationZh: 個人收據證明實際由員工付款；送達確認的證明對象不同。
evidence: that amount is billed to the company / a personal card receipt shows what the employee actually paid / substantiate an out-of-pocket expense

vocabulary.note: 報帳時指本人先從自己的資金支付的費用。
